name: Triumph Thruxton 1200
engine: 1200 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Triumph's modern cafe racer. Bikes with the accessory cafe fairing had a wiring recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2016-2018 bikes fitted with the accessory cafe racer fairing are in recall 19E029 because the fairing can damage the wiring.
A-002.reason: Damaged wiring can kill the lights or stall the engine. The fix is free.

recalls.what: The accessory cafe fairing may damage the wiring, causing loss of lights or a stall.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the wire conduits free.
